ios.desc:
Space4Links helps you save, organize, and rediscover links without the chaos of browser bookmarks.

Use Space4Links to keep everything in one place:
- Save links from mobile and the web
- Organize links into focused folders
- Group folders into workspaces for different areas of life
- Add descriptions and tags for context
- Find anything fast with search by title, URL, and tags
- Share public folders when you want to collaborate or publish resources

Built for people who collect useful links every day:
- Students and researchers
- Product, engineering, and design teams
- Creators curating references and resources
- Anyone who wants a cleaner, searchable bookmark workflow

Space4Links makes link management simple: capture quickly, structure clearly, and find what matters when you need it.
